data.name: Marshal Spirit
data.description: A marshal spirit is a towering presence and an inspiration to others.&nl;

raw_tokens.value: A marshal spirit is a towering presence and an inspiration to others.&nl;
Favored Locations: Council rooms, stages, theaters, throne rooms.&nl; |PREVARLT:SpiritHideLocation,1

Influence Penalty: The time you spend concentrating on your allies prevents you from attending to other important matters. You take a -%1 penalty on Wisdom checks and Wisdom-based skill checks. Additionally, if you are not at least nominally in charge of your present allies, you lose the marshal's spirit bonus and seance boon.&nl; Taboos: Choose one: you may not allow yourself or your allies to prevent a fleeing enemy from escaping, since an at-large villain makes a better tale (this applies only to enemies seeking to escape, not to those retreating to alert others or fight again from a better position); you may never leave an ally behind or allow yourself or your allies to sacrifice another ally, even a summoned creature; you must embrace any opportunity to spread the legend of yourself and your allies, even when a low profile would be helpful.|SpiritBonus
